title: ParetoQ: Improving Scaling Laws in Extremely Low-bit LLM Quantization
first_author: Liu, Zhao, Huang, Chen, Zhang, Zhao, ... Chandra
method: Unified QAT framework for 1-4 bit with optimized training schemes and quantization functions; fine-tunes pretrained models into low-bit.
headline_claim: Learning transition between 2 and 3 bits: >=3-bit models stay near the pretrained distribution; ternary 600M beats prior ternary 3B
path_relevance: Quantization-aware continued training of an existing base.

title: Scaling Laws for Upcycling Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
first_author: Liew, Kato, Takase
method: Empirical scaling laws for dense-to-MoE upcycling as a function of dense tokens, upcycled tokens and MoE configuration.
headline_claim: A 'novel interaction term between the dense and upcycled training dataset ... limits the efficiency of upcycling at large computational budgets'; sparser MoEs with more active parameters upcycle better
path_relevance: Tells when upcycling an open dense base beats from-scratch MoE training.

title: TransMLA: Multi-Head Latent Attention Is All You Need
first_author: Meng, Tang, Tang, Yao, Sun, Zhang
affiliations: Peking University, BIGAI, Tencent Youtu, Xiaomi
tier_evidence: proceedings.neurips.cc 2025 hash 75d13a472f570755af2a4ae4ac3d6724 (title 'TransMLA: Migrating GQA Models to MLA with Full DeepSeek Compatibility and Speedup')
method: Converts any GQA model to MLA (RoRoPE, FreqFold, balanced KV PCA) so it runs on DeepSeek inference stacks; short recovery training.
headline_claim: 93% KV-cache compression with 10x speedup at 8K; 6B tokens restore performance; 68.75% compression training-free costs only 1.65% vs 21.85% for MHA2MLA
path_relevance: KV-cache-aware post-hoc attention conversion of open GQA bases.

title: STAR: Spectral Truncation and Rescale for Model Merging
first_author: Lee, Ko, Pedapati, Chung, Yeh, Chen
affiliations: National Taiwan University, IBM Research, Academia Sinica
method: Truncates small spectral components of task vectors and rescales to preserve nuclear norm.
headline_claim: Up to 4.2% over baselines when merging 12 models
path_relevance: TIES successor (data-free).

title: LESA: Learnable LLM Layer Scaling-Up
first_author: Yang, Cao, Ma, Yao, Qin, Chen, Zhao
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University and collaborators
method: Learns inter-layer parameter patterns via SVD of concatenated layer weights and predicts inserted layers for depth up-scaling before CPT.
headline_claim: Outperforms depth-scaling baselines with less than half the CPT compute
path_relevance: Depth up-scaling / layer stacking of an open base with better initialization.

title: Towards Economical Inference: Enabling DeepSeek's Multi-Head Latent Attention in Any Transformer-based LLMs (MHA2MLA)
first_author: Ji, Guo, Wu, Guo, Shen, Zhan, Qiu, Zhang, Gui
affiliations: Fudan University, ECNU, Shanghai AI Lab
method: Partial-RoPE removal by contribution ranking plus joint SVD of key/value projections to fit MLA, then data-efficient fine-tuning.
headline_claim: Llama2-7B KV cache reduced 92.19% with 1% LongBench drop; compatible with KV quantization to 96.87% reduction
path_relevance: Same conversion target as TransMLA; peer-reviewed at ACL.

title: Drop-Upcycling: Training Sparse Mixture of Experts with Partial Re-initialization
first_author: Nakamura, Akiba, Fujii, Oda, Yokota, Suzuki
affiliations: Institute of Science Tokyo, Sakana AI, NII LLMC, Tohoku University, RIKEN
tier_evidence: arXiv listing 'to appear at ICLR 2025'; OpenReview gx1wHnf5Vp
method: Upcycles a dense checkpoint into MoE while statistically re-initializing part of each expert's weights to promote specialization.
largest_scale: 5.9B-active MoE trained on hundreds of billions of tokens
headline_claim: MoE with 5.9B active params matches a 13B dense model at ~1/4 the training FLOPs; outperforms prior upcycling in long-term training
path_relevance: Fixes the known slow-down of naive sparse upcycling of open dense bases.

title: LongRoPE2: Near-Lossless LLM Context Window Scaling
first_author: Shang, Zhang, Wang, Zhang, Lopez, Yang, Chen, Yang
method: Needle-driven evolutionary RoPE rescaling for under-trained high dimensions plus mixed-context-window training keeping original RoPE for short contexts.
headline_claim: LLaMA3-8B reaches 128K effective context retaining >98.5% short-context performance with 10B tokens, 80x fewer than Meta's recipe
path_relevance: Position-interpolation successor with strongest peer-reviewed evidence; 100B+ evidence still absent.

title: Liger: Linearizing Large Language Models to Gated Recurrent Structures
first_author: Lan, Sun, Hu, Du, Cheng
tier_evidence: ICML 2025 poster (OpenReview 1PfZs0xC2v 'ICML 2025 poster'; PMLR v267 pp. 32452-32466)
method: Repurposes pretrained key-projection weights to build gates for GLA/HGRN2/GSA recurrent layers, then LoRA fine-tunes; Liger Attention intra-layer hybrid.
headline_claim: Recovers 93% of Llama-3 performance at 0.02% of pretraining tokens with 0.085% trainable parameters; gap narrows with scale (4.8% at 1B -> 1.8% at 8B)
path_relevance: Cheapest softmax-to-linear conversion recipe on an open base.

title: DeRS: Towards Extremely Efficient Upcycled Mixture-of-Experts Models
first_author: Huang, Ye, Huang, Cao, Zhang, Li, Yu, Chen
affiliations: Fudan University, CUHK, Shanghai AI Lab, Baidu USA, StepFun
tier_evidence: openaccess.thecvf.com CVPR 2025 paper Huang_DeRS_...; cvpr.thecvf.com poster 32392
method: Decomposes upcycled experts into a shared base plus lightweight (sparse/low-rank) deltas for compression and for upcycling.
headline_claim: Delta-form upcycling adds only 1.1-2.4M parameters (1000-2000x fewer) at equal or better performance
path_relevance: Parameter-efficient upcycling variant.

title: Continual Pre-training of MoEs: How robust is your router?
first_author: Therien, Joseph, Sarwar, Panda, Das, Zhang, Rawls, Sahu, Belilovsky, Rish
affiliations: Mila / Universite de Montreal, Concordia, UChicago, Princeton, Capital One
tier_evidence: 'Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (09/2025)' (alphaXiv rendering of v2 header); OpenReview dR7C1K71Rs
method: Large-scale CPT study of dense vs four 2B MoE transformers (Switch and DeepSeek-style granular) trained 600B tokens, ablating replay %, infinite LR schedules and routing algorithm; introduces Maximum Routing Imbalance metric.
headline_claim: MoEs with Sinkhorn- or penalty-balanced routers are surprisingly robust to distribution shift even without replay; with replay + infinite LR they match full re-training at a fraction of cost; replay trades forgetting for adaptation
path_relevance: Direct evidence on replay ratio, LR re-warm/re-decay and router behaviour when continuing an MoE base; supports CPT of open MoE checkpoints.
frontier_adoption: None named; Qwen3/DeepSeek cited as target use case

title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
first_author: Yu, Zhang, Zhu, Yuan, Zuo, Yue, ... et al. (35 authors)
method: Clip-higher, dynamic sampling, token-level PG loss, overlong reward shaping on top of GRPO; fully open code/data on verl.
headline_claim: 50 on AIME 2024 from Qwen2.5-32B base with 50% of the steps of DeepSeek-R1-Zero-Qwen-32B (47)
path_relevance: Reference open RLVR recipe on an open base; adopted as the baseline algorithm by ProRL, AReaL and others.
frontier_adoption: Techniques adopted in ProRL (NVIDIA), AReaL, many open post-training runs

title: SWAN-GPT: An Efficient and Scalable Approach for Long-Context Language Modeling
first_author: Puvvada, Ladhak, Akle Serrano, Hsieh, Acharya, Majumdar, Jia, Kriman, Sun, Rekesh, Ginsburg
tier_evidence: aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.123 ('SWAN: An Efficient and Scalable Approach for Long-Context ...')
method: Interleaves NoPE global layers with SWA-RoPE local layers (1:3) and dynamic attention scaling; converts an existing RoPE model by CPT.
largest_scale: 8B RoPE model (15T pretraining) converted with 315B CPT tokens at 32K (~2% of original compute)
headline_claim: Converted model generalizes far beyond training length without long-context training; conversion costs ~2% of pretraining compute
path_relevance: Position-encoding swap (RoPE -> NoPE hybrid) applied post hoc to an open-style base.
frontier_adoption: NVIDIA (Nemotron lineage); Cohere and Llama 4 use related RoPE/NoPE interleaving

title: RADLADS: Rapid Attention Distillation to Linear Attention Decoders at Scale
first_author: Goldstein, Alcaide, Lu, Cheah
tier_evidence: OpenReview 38GehGepDd PDF header 'Published as a conference paper at COLM 2025'
method: Three-stage protocol (attention weight transfer, hidden-state alignment, KL distribution matching, short finetune) converting Qwen2.5 7B/32B/72B to RWKV-variant linear attention.
largest_scale: Qwen2.5-72B, 350-700M conversion tokens (<0.005% of teacher tokens), <$2,000
headline_claim: State-of-the-art linear-attention models at 7B/32B/72B; quality 'remains close to the original transformer'
path_relevance: Largest-scale open softmax-to-linear conversion; backbone pipeline reused by the KL-guided hybrid work.
frontier_adoption: None (pipeline reused by ICLR 2026 hybrid distillation)

title: ReplaceMe: Network Simplification via Depth Pruning and Transformer Block Linearization
first_author: Shopkhoev, Ali, Zhussip, Malykh, Lefkimmiatis, Komodakis, Zagoruyko
method: Replaces a contiguous block of transformer layers with a calibrated linear map merged into the preceding block (training-free).
headline_claim: 92.5% of Llama-2-7B performance at 25% compression with no healing; healing still required at high ratios
path_relevance: Layer dropping with (optional) recovery.

title: Reinforcement Learning Finetunes Small Subnetworks in Large Language Models
first_author: Mukherjee, Yuan, Hakkani-Tur, Peng
method: Measures parameter-update sparsity across 7 RL algorithms and 10 LLMs.
headline_claim: RL updates only 5-30% of parameters; subnetworks overlap across seeds and algorithms
path_relevance: Explains why RL checkpoints merge well and why LoRA suffices for RL.

title: ProRL: Prolonged Reinforcement Learning Expands Reasoning Boundaries in Large Language Models
first_author: Liu, Diao, Lu, Hu, Dong, Choi, Kautz, Dong
tier_evidence: OpenReview YPsJha5HXQ; search result states 'ProRL was published for NeurIPS 2025' (proceedings page not fetched)
method: Prolonged RL (>2k steps) with KL control, reference-policy resets and diverse tasks on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B.
headline_claim: Prolonged RL uncovers strategies inaccessible to the base even under extensive sampling; gains generalize OOD
path_relevance: Evidence that RL compute on an open base keeps paying past standard budgets.
frontier_adoption: NVIDIA Nemotron research models; BroRL follow-up

title: AReaL: A Large-Scale Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning System for Language Reasoning
first_author: Fu, Gao, Shen, Zhu, Mei, He, Xu, Guo, Mei, Wang, Yang, Yuan, Wu
tier_evidence: OpenReview qJ0okaW9Z9; search result states presented at NeurIPS 2025 (proceedings page not fetched)
method: Fully asynchronous RL with staleness-controlled rollouts and staleness-enhanced PPO.
headline_claim: Up to 2.77x training speedup with matched or better accuracy
path_relevance: Infrastructure making large RL on open bases affordable; DAPO implemented in AReaL.
frontier_adoption: Ant Group Ring models; slime (Z.ai) is the analogous stack

title: OpenThoughts: Data Recipes for Reasoning Models
first_author: Guha, Marten, Keh, Raoof, Smyrnis, Bansal, ... et al. (50 authors)
affiliations: Stanford, UW, Bespoke Labs, TRI and collaborators
tier_evidence: OpenReview fNh86fMBxS PDF header 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026' (also COLM 2025 per search)
method: 1,000+ controlled ablations of SFT data generation for reasoning; OpenThoughts3-1.2M with QwQ-32B teacher.
headline_claim: OpenThoughts3-7B: 53% AIME 2025, 51% LiveCodeBench; OpenThinker2-32B matches R1-Distill-32B with public data
path_relevance: Open SFT data recipe that takes an open base to distilled-reasoner level.
frontier_adoption: Used by Olmo 3 (Dolci), Nemotron post-training mixes

title: The Common Pile v0.1: An 8TB Dataset of Public Domain and Openly Licensed Text
first_author: Kandpal, Lester, Raffel, Majstorovic, Biderman, ... et al.
affiliations: University of Toronto / Vector, EleutherAI, Hugging Face, AI2 and others
tier_evidence: papers.nips.cc 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track file 52acc050138d6f40dad6f12f91a4ce22; OpenReview DIELgiqdvJ
method: 8TB openly licensed corpus with license-laundering controls; trains Comma v0.1 7B for 1T/2T tokens.
headline_claim: Comma 7B is competitive with Llama 1/2 7B trained on unlicensed text; gap to FineWeb remains
path_relevance: Licensing treated as a training constraint; excludes synthetic data due to unclear licensing of LLM outputs.

title: EvoLM: In Search of Lost Language Model Training Dynamics
first_author: Qi, Nie, Alahi, Zou, Lakkaraju, Du, Xing, Kakade, Zhang
tier_evidence: proceedings.neurips.cc 2025 hash 778cc31583604ebf246726055e9f737f (title 'EvoLM: In Search of Lost Training Dynamics for Language Model Reasoning'); OpenReview B6bE2GC71a
method: Trains >100 LMs (1B, 4B) from scratch and through CPT, SFT and RL to isolate stage-wise effects on in/out-of-domain reasoning.
headline_claim: Diminishing returns from excessive pre- and post-training; forgetting mitigation during domain CPT is crucial; CPT is the key enabler of downstream RL gains
path_relevance: Controlled evidence on how much CPT on a base is worth before post-training and how to measure forgetting.

title: Memory Decoder: A Pretrained, Plug-and-Play Memory for Large Language Models
first_author: Cao, Wang, Wei, Guo, Chen, Zhou, Lin
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (LUMIA Lab), Shanghai AI Lab
method: Small decoder pretrained to imitate a kNN-LM retriever, interpolated with any base sharing the tokenizer at inference (no base weight change).
largest_scale: 0.5B memory applied to Qwen and Llama families
headline_claim: Reduces perplexity by 6.17 on average across biomedicine/finance/law with 1.28x overhead and no catastrophic forgetting
path_relevance: Post-hoc memory/retrieval module added to an open base without CPT.

title: Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model with Post Neural Architecture Search
first_author: Gu, Hu, Yang, Xi, Chen, Han, Cai
method: PostNAS: start from a pretrained full-attention model, freeze MLPs, learn full-attention layer placement, select/design linear-attention block (JetBlock), hardware-aware hyperparameter search; converts Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B.
headline_claim: Jet-Nemotron-2B matches/exceeds Qwen3-1.7B-Base accuracy with 53.6x generation throughput at 256K; PostNAS steps add +5.3 MMLU, +8.4 math, +7.8 retrieval over naive conversion
path_relevance: Converting an open dense base into a hybrid linear/full-attention model without pretraining from scratch; GLM-5 adopted PostNAS-style search for its SWA ablation.
frontier_adoption: GLM-5 report cites and follows the Jet-Nemotron pipeline for GDN conversion ablations

title: Apertus: Democratizing Open and Compliant LLMs for Global Language Environments
first_author: Hernandez-Cano, Hagele, Huang, Romanou, Solergibert, Pasztor, ... et al. (102 authors)
affiliations: EPFL, ETH Zurich, CSCS (Swiss AI Initiative)
method: Pretrains 8B/70B on 15T tokens with retroactive robots.txt opt-out (Jan 2025) applied to 2013-2024 crawls, PII/toxicity filtering, Goldfish loss, license-filtered post-training data.
headline_claim: Retroactive opt-out removes ~8% English / 4% multilingual tokens; approaches SOTA among fully open models
path_relevance: Provenance and consent as explicit training constraints at 70B.

title: REAP the Experts: Why Pruning Prevails for One-Shot MoE Compression
first_author: Lasby, Lazarevich, Sinnadurai, Lie, Ioannou, Thangarasa
tier_evidence: GitHub bibtex 'The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations 2026', OpenReview ukGxWd2aDG; mlanthology iclr/2026
method: Router-weighted expert activation saliency for one-shot expert pruning; proves expert merging causes 'functional subspace collapse'.
headline_claim: Near-lossless (<=2% drop) code generation after pruning 50% of experts from Qwen3-Coder-480B and Kimi-K2; merging fails on generative tasks
path_relevance: Expert pruning of frontier open MoEs as a better-model-per-FLOP route; negative result for expert merging.

title: Distilling to Hybrid Attention Models via KL-Guided Layer Selection
first_author: Li, Yang, Tan, Mishra, Panda, Zhou, Kim
method: Scores each layer by KL reduction when restored to softmax in an all-linear (GDN) student, keeps top-K softmax layers, then runs RADLADS distillation for the hybrid.
headline_claim: KL-guided greedy selection 'consistently and substantially outperforms all other baselines' on RULER and SWDE versus fixed-ratio interleaving and diagnostic-dataset selection
path_relevance: Answers which layers to keep as full attention when converting an open base to a hybrid.

title: Enough is as good as a feast: A Comprehensive Analysis of How Reinforcement Learning Mitigates Task Conflicts in LLMs
first_author: Ren, Lu, Wu, Zhao, ... (CASIA, Baidu)
affiliations: Institute of Automation CAS, UCAS, Baidu
tier_evidence: proceedings.iclr.cc 2026 file 2abb64561fc02424152256eef40f220e header 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026'
method: Analyses how RL-trained specialists (vs SFT) reduce task-vector conflicts when merged.
headline_claim: RL-trained experts merge with less interference than SFT experts
path_relevance: Merging RL checkpoints as a substitute for multi-task RL.

title: Rope to Nope and Back Again: A New Hybrid Attention Strategy
first_author: Yang, Venkitesh, Talupuru, Lin, Cairuz, Blunsom, Locatelli
tier_evidence: OpenReview Tp6ds3Dfqo exists; search snippet indicates NeurIPS 2025 acceptance but not confirmed on proceedings.neurips.cc
method: RNoPE-SWA: interleaves NoPE full-attention layers with RoPE sliding-window layers (1:3), removes QK-norm; pretrained to 5T tokens with 8K->32K->128K anneal.
headline_claim: Nearly 4x KV-cache reduction with long-context performance that 'eliminates the need for RoPE scaling'
path_relevance: Position-encoding design that removes the need for YaRN-style extension; trained from scratch (baseline for conversion work).
frontier_adoption: Cohere Command family; Llama 4 iRoPE is analogous

title: Scaling Laws for Forgetting during Finetuning with Pretraining Data Injection
first_author: Bethune, Grangier, Busbridge, Gualdoni, Cuturi, Ablin
tier_evidence: OpenReview forum vWMij23BmQ (submission with reviews found)
method: Fits scaling laws for target-domain loss and forgetting as a function of finetuning tokens and fraction of injected pretraining data.
headline_claim: Injecting a small fraction of pretraining data into finetuning is a predictable lever against forgetting; laws predict the optimal injection ratio
path_relevance: Replay-ratio selection for CPT/mid-training of an open base.

title: From 128K to 4M: Efficient Training of Ultra-Long Context Large Language Models (UltraLong)
first_author: Xu, Wei, Xu, Liu, Wang, Shoeybi, Li, Catanzaro
tier_evidence: Search snippet indicates COLM 2025 but not confirmed on colmweb/openreview
method: Efficient CPT recipe from an aligned Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct: YaRN-based scaling with special document separators and a short 1B-token stage per length, then instruction tuning.
headline_claim: RULER 80.17 within 1M tokens; both YaRN scaling and separators shown necessary
path_relevance: YaRN-successor curriculum evidence on an open base (8B scale).

title: MergeBench: A Benchmark for Merging Domain-Specialized LLMs
first_author: He, Zeng, Hu, Yang, Zhang, Zhao
method: Standardized finetuning/eval protocol for merging Llama and Gemma 2B-9B specialists across five domains with eight merging methods.
headline_claim: All merging methods lie between the base and individual finetunes; sophisticated methods can underperform Task Arithmetic
path_relevance: Null-result evidence on merging quality at 9B scale.

title: Scaling Law for Quantization-Aware Training
first_author: Chen, Zhang, Liu, Zeng, Xue, Liu, Li, Ma, Huang, Zhou, Luo
method: 268 QAT experiments modelling W4A4 quantization error vs size, tokens and group size.
headline_claim: Quantization error falls with model size but rises with more tokens and coarser groups; FC2 activation outliers are the W4A4 bottleneck
path_relevance: Predicts QAT cost when continuing a large base at low precision.

title: Foreign Sparse Attention: Effective Distillation into Sparse Attention
first_author: Sundarapandiyan, Goldstein, Panda
tier_evidence: OpenReview forum Y50Mdo9k1v (2025-06-10) and PDF SUupmv3fn4; no arXiv abs page found
method: Four-stage distillation (parameter transfer, attention-head alignment, block alignment, GRPO trace correction) converting a global-attention reasoner into Native Sparse Attention with 100M tokens.
headline_claim: Distilled NSA student 'performs competitively with the teacher', in some cases improving accuracy while generating fewer tokens
path_relevance: Dense-to-sparse (NSA) conversion by distillation; authors note NSA 'has not been validated at the scale of frontier pretrained model releases'.

title: GPTailor: Large Language Model Pruning Through Layer Cutting and Stitching
first_author: Su, Shen, Yin, Liu, Yang, Geiping
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, ELLIS Tubingen and collaborators
method: Zero-order search over layer removal, selection from finetuned variants and task-arithmetic layer merging.
headline_claim: Retains 97.3% of Llama2-13B performance after removing ~25% of parameters without post-training
path_relevance: Combines pruning with merging of finetuned variants.

title: Progressive Depth Up-scaling via Optimal Transport (OpT-DeUS)
first_author: Cao, Wang, Aletras
method: Aligns neurons across adjacent blocks with optimal transport before fusing them into new layers for progressive depth growth.
headline_claim: Better performance and training efficiency than copy/average depth up-scaling in CPT and SFT across model sizes
path_relevance: Function-preserving depth growth.

title: Compute-Optimal Quantization-Aware Training
first_author: Dremov, Grangier, Katharopoulos, Hannun
method: 757 experiments (86M-2.2B) fitting a loss law over FP tokens, QAT tokens and bit width; cooldown+QAT fusion.
headline_claim: Optimal QAT fraction grows with tokens-per-parameter-byte (the '10% is optimal' rule fails); same loss reachable with ~50% compute at low bits
path_relevance: How much of a CPT budget to spend in QAT when targeting a quantized open model.

title: Dense2MoE: Pushing the Pareto Frontier of On-Device LLMs via Unified Pruning and Upcycling
first_author: Li, Ji, Ding, Ren, Wei
tier_evidence: Earlier version 'Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2026' (OpenReview hYGPetyGSr)
method: Layer-Fusion Upcycling: prunes attention of redundant layers and repurposes their MLPs as heterogeneous experts, then 225B tokens of CPT.
headline_claim: Advances the latency-accuracy Pareto frontier vs dense, pruning and standard upcycling; <1% of from-scratch MoE compute
path_relevance: Upcycling + pruning hybrid on open bases.

title: Qwen2.5-1M Technical Report
first_author: Yang, Yu, Li, Liu, Huang, Huang, ... et al.
method: Progressive long-context CPT from 4K to 256K with synthetic long data, then DCA + YaRN-style scaling to 1M at inference; sparse-attention serving.
headline_claim: 1M-token models with strong RULER at 1M; 3-7x prefill speedup
path_relevance: Disclosed 128K->1M curriculum on open Qwen bases.

title: Nemotron-H: A Family of Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models
first_author: NVIDIA (Blakeman, Basant, Khattar, ...) et al.
method: MiniPuzzle: importance estimation, conditional NAS under a 32GiB memory constraint, short distillation of top-3 candidates, 63B-token logit distillation to compress 56B -> 47B.
largest_scale: 56B hybrid -> 47B with 63B tokens (~300x fewer than from scratch)
headline_claim: 47B matches 56B accuracy at 1.2x faster long-context inference; Mamba head pruning 'caused severe accuracy degradation'
path_relevance: Pruning + distillation of a hybrid base; documents which axes fail.

title: Llama-Nemotron: Efficient Reasoning Models
first_author: Bercovich, Levy, Golan, Dabbah, El-Yaniv, Puny, ... et al. (136 authors)
tier_evidence: NVIDIA technical report, arXiv 2505.00949 (ICML 2025 workshop talk)
method: Puzzle NAS + FFN fusion from Llama 3.1-405B/3.3-70B, 65B-token KD + 88B-token CPT, then SFT on R1 traces and large-scale RL (FP8 generation).
headline_claim: LN-Ultra surpasses Llama 3.1-405B-Instruct and DeepSeek-R1 on GPQA-D while fitting one 8xH100 node with 1.71x lower latency
path_relevance: Strongest documented case of PATH 3 end-to-end: prune a leading open base, recover by KD+CPT, exceed it via RL.

title: Qwen3 Technical Report
first_author: Yang, Li, Yang, Zhang, Hui, Zheng, ... et al.
method: Thinking/non-thinking fusion; strong-to-weak (off-policy then on-policy) distillation from 235B flagship to small models; four-stage post-training.
headline_claim: Distillation from the flagship yields small models outperforming RL-trained counterparts at lower cost
path_relevance: Open bases most used by DAPO/ProRL/OPD work; establishes strong-to-weak OPD.

title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
first_author: Kimi Team (Bai, Bao, Charles, ...) et al.
method: 1T-A32B MoE with MuonClip; large-scale agentic data synthesis and joint RL; K2 Thinking adds INT4 QAT in post-training.
headline_claim: Zero loss spikes over 15.5T tokens; K2 Thinking native INT4 with ~2x generation speedup 'lossless' (model card)
path_relevance: Open base used by REAP (50% expert pruning) and a source of QAT-in-post-training evidence.

title: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
first_author: OpenAI (Agarwal, Ahmad, Ai, Altman, ...) et al.
method: MoE with MXFP4-quantized experts released natively; reasoning-effort levels; harmony format.
headline_claim: Open-weight models shipped with MXFP4 expert weights and configurable reasoning effort
path_relevance: Open base with native low-precision weights (constraint for CPT/RL on it).

title: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2: An Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Reasoning Model
first_author: NVIDIA (Basant, Khairnar, Paithankar, ...) et al.
method: Pretrain 12B on 20T tokens (FP8, WSD), align, then Minitron-style depth (62->56 layers) and width pruning with 60B-token distillation under a 19.66 GiB budget.
headline_claim: On-par or better than Qwen3-8B at up to 6x throughput; pruning below 56 layers 'results in significant accuracy degradation'
path_relevance: Full open recipe for prune-and-distill of an aligned reasoning model.

title: Kimi K2 Thinking model card (Native INT4 Quantization)
first_author: Moonshot AI
method: QAT in the post-training phase with INT4 weight-only quantization of MoE components.
headline_claim: 'native INT4 inference with a roughly 2x generation speed improvement while achieving state-of-the-art performance'; all benchmarks reported under INT4
path_relevance: Frontier evidence for QAT as a post-training stage on an open base.

title: DeepSeek-V3.2: Pushing the Frontier of Open Large Language Models
first_author: DeepSeek-AI (Liu, Mei, Lin, Xue, ...) et al.
tier_evidence: DeepSeek technical report, arXiv 2512.02556; also GitHub deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp
method: Dense-to-sparse attention conversion by continued pretraining from V3.1-Terminus: 1000-step dense warm-up training only the lightning indexer (KL to dense attention, 2.1B tokens), then sparse stage co-training model + indexer (top-k=2048, 15000 steps, 943.7B tokens); then specialist distillation + mixed RL.
headline_claim: DSA reduces core attention O(L^2)->O(Lk) with 'virtually identical' benchmarks vs V3.1-Terminus (e.g. MMLU-Pro 85.0 vs 85.0); V3.2-Speciale reaches IMO/IOI gold
path_relevance: Canonical frontier-scale evidence that an attention architecture can be swapped post hoc on an open base by CPT.
frontier_adoption: DeepSeek-V3.2 / V3.2-Exp; recipe copied by GLM-5, GLM-4.7-Flash ablation

title: Olmo 3
first_author: Team OLMo (Ettinger, Bertsch, Kuehl, ...) et al.
method: Fully open model flow: 5.9T pretraining, a named 100B-token midtraining stage (Dolma 3 Dolmino), 50-100B long-context stage, then SFT->DPO->RLVR (OlmoRL) Think/Instruct/RL-Zero paths; midtraining run twice and merged.
headline_claim: Olmo 3.1 Think 32B is the strongest fully-open thinking model; competitive with Qwen3-32B thinking on 6x fewer tokens; RL gives 4x speedup and gains at each post-training stage
path_relevance: Disclosed open mid-training + long-context + RLVR recipe on a base the user can fork at any checkpoint; midtraining checkpoint merging.
frontier_adoption: Olmo 3 itself (AI2); midtraining-as-stage also used by GLM-5, Nemotron 3

title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3: Efficient and Open Intelligence
first_author: NVIDIA (Blakeman, Grattafiori, Basant, ...) et al.
tier_evidence: NVIDIA technical report, arXiv 2512.20856; recipe docs at docs.nvidia.com/nemotron
method: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE family (Nano/Super/Ultra) with LatentMoE, MTP, two-phase 25T-token curriculum, checkpoint merging in the stable-LR phase, long-context extension to 1M, SFT + multi-environment RLVR; full training recipe released.
headline_claim: Open recipe (pretrain, SFT, RL, quantization) reproducible from docs; Super trained on 25T tokens with 1M context
path_relevance: Second fully disclosed frontier-adjacent recipe (with OLMo 3) including checkpoint merging and mid-phase data re-weighting.

title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
first_author: GLM-5 Team (Zeng, Lv, Hou, Du, Zheng, ...) et al.
tier_evidence: Z.ai technical report, arXiv 2602.15763 v2; GitHub zai-org/GLM-5
method: 744B-A40B MoE pretrained 28.5T tokens; DSA introduced by CPT from the end-of-mid-training MLA checkpoint: 1000-step indexer warm-up (14 x 202,752-token seqs/step, LR 5e-3) then only 20B tokens of sparse adaptation; ablation of SWA/GDN/PostNAS-searched conversions on GLM-9B; asynchronous RL (slime) with on-policy cross-stage distillation.
headline_claim: 20B-token DSA adaptation (vs 943.7B for DeepSeek-V3.2) 'is enough to adapt the DSA model to match the performance of the original MLA model'; naive interleaved SWA conversion loses 30.35 on RULER@128K while DSA is 'lossless by construction'
path_relevance: Seed report: cheapest disclosed frontier-scale attention conversion; also documents search-based SWA layer selection and GDN/SimpleGDN conversion ablations with retained gaps of up to 5.69 RULER / 7.33 RepoQA points.

title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation
first_author: Yang, Liu, Chen, Dai, Wang, Lin, Lee, ... Ping
method: Sequential cascade RL with multi-domain OPD from the strongest intermediate checkpoints to recover regressions.
headline_claim: Gold-medal territory at IMO, IOI and ICPC 2025 with ~20x fewer parameters than DeepSeek 671B
path_relevance: 'Post-training open weights to frontier' claim with disclosed method.

title: Nemotron 3 Super: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
first_author: NVIDIA (Chandiramani, Blakeman, Olaoye, ...) et al. (547 authors)
tier_evidence: NVIDIA technical report, arXiv 2604.12374; recipe at docs.nvidia.com/nemotron/latest/nemotron/super3
method: 120.6B-A12.7B LatentMoE hybrid with MTP (2 shared-weight heads), 25T-token two-phase pretraining, checkpoint merging in stable LR phase, long-context to 1M, SFT + multi-environment RLVR + SWE-RL + RLHF, FP8/NVFP4 PTQ; distillation recipe.
headline_claim: Complete reproducible pipeline including pretrain, SFT, RL, quantization released
path_relevance: Disclosed open recipe (family 1) with MTP and 1M extension (families 2, 6).

title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
first_author: DeepSeek-AI (Xu, Lin, Xue, Wang, ...) et al.
method: Hybrid CSA/HCA compressed-sparse attention, mHC residuals, Muon; 32T tokens; post-training replaces mixed RL with on-policy distillation to merge expert capabilities.
headline_claim: 27% of V3.2 single-token FLOPs and 10% of KV cache at 1M; OPD is 'the primary technique for merging expert capabilities' (quoted via secondary source)
path_relevance: Frontier confirmation that OPD replaced weight merging/mixed RL; sparse-attention lineage continues from V3.2 conversion.

title: SlimQwen: Exploring the Pruning and Distillation in Large MoE Model Pre-training
first_author: Tang, Wang, Zheng, Wang, Men, Zhang, Yuan, Qiu, Shen, Liu
method: Systematic study of structured pruning + KD at pretraining scale for MoEs: pruned init vs from-scratch, expert compression choices, distillation objectives.
headline_claim: Pruning provides a better initialization than from-scratch for continued training; expert-compression choices materially affect the final model
path_relevance: Minitron-style pruning applied to frontier MoE bases by the lab that owns them.

title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
first_author: NVIDIA (Blakeman, Thomas, Jhunjhunwala, Gupta, ...) et al. (574 authors)
tier_evidence: NVIDIA technical report, arXiv 2606.15007; research.nvidia.com PDF dated 2026-06-09
method: 550B-A55B hybrid Mamba-Attention LatentMoE pretrained in NVFP4 on 20T tokens (15T diversity + 5T quality), context extended to 1M, post-trained with SFT, RLVR and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) from specialised teachers; MTP boosting.
headline_claim: Up to ~6x inference throughput vs GLM-5.1/Kimi-K2.6/Qwen-3.5 at on-par accuracy; NVFP4 pretraining loss gap <0.4% vs BF16
path_relevance: Open recipe combining 1M extension and MOPD consolidation; confirms MOPD as the specialist-merge step at NVIDIA.

title: GLM-5.2: Built for Long-Horizon Tasks (Z.ai blog)
first_author: Z.ai / Zhipu AI
method: IndexShare (one DSA indexer per 4 layers) trained from mid-training at 128K; 1M-context coding-agent training; improved MTP with KV-share; post-training consolidates >10 expert models via parallel on-policy distillation on slime in ~2 days; critic-based PPO with anti-reward-hacking gates.
headline_claim: 2.9x lower per-token FLOPs at 1M; MTP acceptance length +20% (4.56 -> 5.47); 'efficiently merging more than ten expert models into the final model' by OPD in ~two days
path_relevance: Frontier evidence for OPD-based consolidation replacing weight merging of RL specialists.

title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
first_author: Kimi Team
tier_evidence: Moonshot technical report, arXiv 2607.24653 (v2 abs fetched)
method: 2.8T-A104B MoE with Kimi Delta Attention hybrid (3 KDA : 1 gated MLA), AttnRes, Stable LatentMoE; QAT with MXFP4 weights / MXFP8 activations from SFT through RL with rollout-training precision match.
headline_claim: ~2.5x scaling efficiency over K2; QAT throughout post-training eliminates train-inference mismatch
path_relevance: Quantization-aware post-training at the largest open scale; hybrid linear attention trained natively (baseline for conversion work).

title: GLM-5.3: Frontier Coding with Emergent Cyber Capabilities (Z.ai blog) and zai-org/GLM-5 README
first_author: Z.ai / Zhipu AI
method: Same 744B-A40B base as GLM-5.2; scaled post-training only (more environments, more diverse tasks, more compute) using IndexShare, SAO with compaction, slime asynchronous RL, OPD with top-p/top-k/full-vocab variants, training-rollout logprob mismatch at 1e-7.
headline_claim: 'It uses the same base model as GLM-5.2 - every gain comes from post-training'; Terminal-Bench 3.0 4.6 -> 28.3, DeepSwe v1.1 46.2 -> 66.9, Agents' Last Exam 23.8 -> 28.5, CyberGym 77.2 -> 84.5, ExploitBench 24.4 -> 54.4
path_relevance: Cleanest frontier-scale evidence that post-training alone moves an open base substantially.

title: Thus Spake Long-Context Large Language Model
first_author: Liu, Li, Huang, Liu, Song, Guo, ... Qiu
affiliations: Shanghai AI Lab, Fudan University, Huawei Noah's Ark
method: Survey of long-context architecture, infrastructure, training and evaluation.
headline_claim: Comprehensive map of long-context extension methods
path_relevance: Survey (family 6)

title: Extrapolation Merging: Keep Improving With Extrapolation and Merging
first_author: Lin, Xu, Li, Gao
method: Extrapolates along the base-to-finetuned direction and merges to improve without extra data.
headline_claim: Improves instruction-tuned models without additional compute or data
path_relevance: Task-arithmetic successor.

title: What Matters in Linearizing Language Models? A Comparative Study of Architecture, Scale, and Task Adaptation
first_author: Haller, Golde, Akbik
method: Unified linearization setup comparing seven sub-quadratic mixers (xLSTM, GLA, Gated DeltaNet, RetNet, DeltaNet, ...) from 140M to 1.7B on a 3B-token budget.
headline_claim: Performance hierarchies stable from 140M to 1.7B; error-correcting (delta-rule) update rules show superior scaling exponents
path_relevance: Guides mixer choice for conversion; explicitly leaves scaling beyond 1.7B untested.

title: Achieving Tokenizer Flexibility in Language Models through Heuristic Adaptation and Supertoken Learning (TokenAdapt)
first_author: Sharthak, Pahalwan, Kamath, Shirawalmath
method: Hybrid local (sub-token composition) + global (semantic neighbours) initialization for transplanted tokenizers; multi-word supertokens.
headline_claim: Reduces residual fine-tuning after tokenizer replacement
path_relevance: Tokenizer swap on open bases.

title: Token Distillation: Attention-aware Input Embeddings For New Tokens (AweDist)
first_author: Dobler, Elliott, de Melo
affiliations: HPI / University of Potsdam, University of Copenhagen
method: Distils hidden representations obtained with the original tokenization into new-token input embeddings.
headline_claim: Outperforms strong embedding-initialization baselines
path_relevance: Vocabulary extension of open bases.

title: Training-Free Tokenizer Transplantation via Orthogonal Matching Pursuit
first_author: Goddard, Fernandes Neto
method: Reconstructs unseen-token embeddings as sparse combinations of shared anchor tokens (OMP) in donor space, transferred to the base.
headline_claim: Best zero-shot preservation vs zero-init, mean-init, WECHSEL, FOCUS, ZeTT with no gradient updates
path_relevance: Tokenizer transplantation between open bases (prerequisite for cross-family distillation/merging).

title: Your LLM Knows the Future: Uncovering Its Multi-Token Prediction Potential
first_author: Samragh, Kundu, Harrison, Nishu, Naik, Cho, Farajtabar
tier_evidence: No review signal found (Apple ML Research page + arXiv)
method: Adds MTP to a pretrained model post hoc: mask tokens appended to the input, gated LoRA active only on mask positions (frozen backbone), 2-layer MLP sampler, latent consistency loss, quadratic speculative decoding.
largest_scale: Tulu3-8B SFT, k=8 masks, rank-128 gated LoRA
headline_claim: Nearly 5x faster code/math generation and ~2.5x chat 'without any loss in quality'; standard LoRA (ungated) degrades accuracy sharply
path_relevance: Post-hoc MTP heads on an open base; GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V4 instead train MTP natively.
frontier_adoption: None (native MTP in DeepSeek-V3/V4, GLM-5.2, Nemotron 3)

title: Model Merging Scaling Laws in Large Language Models
first_author: Wang, Gu, Zhang, Zhou, Yan, Xie, Wang, Yuan, Yang
method: Fits a power law in model size and number of merged experts for cross-entropy across Average/TA/TIES/DARE.
headline_claim: Gains fall roughly as 1/k in the number of experts; size-dependent floor decreases with capacity; merging is 'a predictable, budget-aware alternative to multitask fine-tuning'
path_relevance: First merging scaling law; informs how many specialists to merge onto a base.

title: LoRA Without Regret
first_author: Schulman et al. (Thinking Machines Lab)
tier_evidence: Blog post (no arXiv, lab not in protocol's C list)
method: Controlled SFT and RL comparisons of LoRA vs full fine-tuning across ranks, batch sizes, datasets.
largest_scale: not stated on page (open Llama/Qwen bases)
headline_claim: LoRA matches full FT for SFT on small/medium data and for RL even at low rank; underperforms when data exceeds LoRA capacity and at large batch
path_relevance: LoRA-at-scale for post-training of open bases; consistent with RL-subnetwork sparsity.

title: BroRL: Scaling Reinforcement Learning via Broadened Exploration
first_author: Hu, Liu, Lu, Wu, Harchaoui, Diao, Choi, Molchanov, Yang, Kautz, Dong
method: Scales rollouts per example to hundreds after ProRL saturates.
headline_claim: Performance plateaus after thousands of ProRL steps; broadened exploration yields continued gains beyond that saturation point
path_relevance: Documents the saturation of prolonged RL on a fixed base and a remedy.

title: Mid-Training of Large Language Models: A Survey
first_author: Mo, Shi, Weng, Zhou, Liu, Zhang, Zeng
method: Survey: first taxonomy of mid-training across data distribution, LR scheduling and long-context extension; compiles recipes from Llama 3, DeepSeek-V3, OLMo 2, Nemotron-4, SmolLM2.
headline_claim: Mid-training is a distinct, coherent stage; scheduler design remains largely empirical
path_relevance: Survey (family 1)

title: Recycling Pretrained Checkpoints: Orthogonal Growth of Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Large Language Model Pre-Training
first_author: Wang, Ding, Liu, Wang, Cheng, Guo, Zha, Gong
affiliations: Microsoft Research Asia, USTC, SJTU, Xiamen University
method: Grows a trained MoE checkpoint orthogonally in depth (layer interposition) and width (expert duplication with noise) and continues pretraining.
headline_claim: Growth from existing checkpoints consistently improves performance for a fixed compute budget versus training from scratch
path_relevance: Model-growth scaling study directly on MoE checkpoints.

title: A Survey on LLM Mid-Training
first_author: Tu, Zhang, Weng, Li, Zhang, Bai, Yan, Wang, Cai
method: Survey: formal definition of mid-training vs continued pretraining; optimization framework over data curation, training strategy, architecture changes, decay scaling laws.
headline_claim: Mid-training delivers steeper gains with less data than pretraining; distinguishes it from CPT that ignores optimizer state and distribution preservation
path_relevance: Survey (family 1)

title: Scaling depth capacity via zero/one-layer model expansion
first_author: Bu
method: Trains small models for ~80% of the budget then expands with zero/one-layer (identity-preserving) blocks to the large depth.
headline_claim: Progressive training cost 6B(tau*N_small + (T-tau)*N_large) with tau ~ 0.8T
path_relevance: Function-preserving depth growth for compute-efficient scaling of a base.

title: On the Interplay of Pre-Training, Mid-Training, and RL on Reasoning Language Models
first_author: Zhang, Neubig, Yue
method: Controlled pipeline varying pretraining data, a named mid-training stage, and RL to test whether post-training extends reasoning beyond what mid-training provides.
headline_claim: Mid-training content largely determines what RL can later elicit; RL gains are bounded by mid-training exposure
path_relevance: Evidence for mid-training as the stage that sets the ceiling of later RLVR on a base.

title: Grow Up and Merge: Scaling Strategies for Efficient Language Adaptation
first_author: Glocker, Kukk, Oji, Bollmann, Kuhlmann, Kunz
method: FLOP-matched ablations of up-scaling an English base before target-language CPT, plus merging of adapted models.
headline_claim: Upscaled models can match or surpass smaller models continually pretrained on much more data once given enough target-language data
path_relevance: Growth + CPT + merge combination for domain/language adaptation of an open base.

title: Extending the Context of Pretrained LLMs by Dropping Their Positional Embeddings (DroPE)
first_author: Gelberg, Eguchi, Akiba, Cetin
method: Drops positional embeddings after pretraining with a short recalibration to extend context without long-sequence finetuning.
headline_claim: Breaks the requirement of expensive finetuning beyond the pretraining length for context extension
path_relevance: NoPE swap on an existing open base as a long-context route.

title: A Unified Generalization Framework for Model Merging: Trade-offs, Non-Linearity, and Scaling Laws
first_author: Li, Tang, Zhang, Wang, Yin, Shen
affiliations: NUDT, Wuhan University, Sun Yat-sen University, Hebei University of Technology
method: Theoretical generalization bounds for merging heterogeneous experts with scaling-law implications.
headline_claim: Unified bound explaining trade-offs and non-linearity in merging
path_relevance: Merging scaling theory.

title: Sparsity-Aware Evolution for Model Merging
first_author: Zhang, Zhang, Wisniewski, Tomeh, Liu
affiliations: Universite Paris Cite / Sorbonne Paris Nord and collaborators
method: Evolutionary merging with iterative prune-merge mutation and sparsity in the fitness score.
headline_claim: Improves merging reliability across benchmarks; orthogonal to existing methods
path_relevance: Evolutionary-merging successor.

title: Learning beyond Teacher: Generalized On-Policy Distillation with Reward Extrapolation (ExOPD)
first_author: Yang, Liu, Xie, Yang, Yang, Lin
method: Shows OPD is dense KL-constrained RL; adds reward scaling >1 and flexible reference so a student distilled from domain-RL experts of the same base can exceed them.
headline_claim: ExOPD lets a unified student 'surpass all domain teachers' when merging RL experts back into the base
path_relevance: OPD as the replacement for weight merging of RL specialists (GLM-5.2 comparison point).
frontier_adoption: GLM-5/5.2, DeepSeek-V4, MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Ultra use OPD variants

title: To Mix or To Merge: Toward Multi-Domain Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
first_author: Wang, Long, Li, Xu, Li, Tang
method: Compares mixed-domain RLVR against per-domain RLVR followed by merging.
headline_claim: Systematic comparison of the two dominant strategies for multi-domain RLVR
path_relevance: Merging vs mixed RL, the comparison GLM-5.2/DeepSeek-V4 resolve with OPD.

title: Model Merging in the Era of Large Language Models: Methods, Applications, and Future Directions
first_author: Song, Zheng
method: Survey (FUSE taxonomy) of merging foundations, strategies, scenarios, ecosystem.
headline_claim: Open challenges: theoretical gaps, scalability barriers, standardization
path_relevance: Survey (family 4)

title: IndexCache: Accelerating Sparse Attention via Cross-Layer Index Reuse
first_author: Bai, Dong, Jiang, Lv, Du, Zeng, Tang, Li
tier_evidence: No review signal found; primary statement of IndexShare used in GLM-5.2
method: Shares the DSA lightning-indexer top-k selection across groups of consecutive layers; training-free greedy search for the sharing layout plus a training-aware multi-layer distillation loss for adaptation.
largest_scale: Applied in GLM-5.2 (744B-A40B) as IndexShare (one indexer per 4 layers)
headline_claim: Removes indexer computation in 3/4 of layers; GLM-5.2 reports 2.9x lower per-token FLOPs at 1M context with better long-context scores than GLM-5.1
path_relevance: Second-order conversion step (sparse -> shared-index sparse) applied by CPT from mid-training at 128K.

title: Bielik-Minitron-7B: Compressing Large Language Models via Structured Pruning and Knowledge Distillation for the Polish Language
first_author: Kinas, Kiszczak, Perez, Ociepa, Flis, Wrobel, Gwozdziej
method: Two-stage Minitron compression of Bielik-11B-v3.0 to 7.35B.
headline_claim: Compressed model optimized for European languages
path_relevance: Minitron applied outside NVIDIA on an open base.

title: Continual Learning in Large Language Models: Methods, Challenges, and Opportunities
first_author: Chen, Sun, Ye, Li, Lin
method: Survey of continual pre-training, continual fine-tuning and continual alignment with forgetting-mechanism taxonomy.
headline_claim: Fundamental challenges persist in seamless knowledge integration across tasks and temporal scales
path_relevance: Survey (family 1)

title: Effective Distillation to Hybrid xLSTM Architectures
first_author: Hauzenberger, Schmidinger, Schmied, Hartl, Stap, Hoedt, Beck, Bock, Klambauer, Hochreiter
method: Distillation of attention LLMs into hybrid xLSTM models with a 'lossless distillation' criterion (tolerance-corrected win-and-tie rates).
headline_claim: Prior distilled sub-quadratic models 'often fail to match the performance of their teacher LLMs'; proposes a lossless-distillation target
path_relevance: Hybrid distillation family; states the null result on prior linearizations.

title: The Finetuner's Fallacy: When to Pretrain with Your Finetuning Data
first_author: Baek, Monti, Schwab, Abbas, Adiga, Blakeney, ..., Raghunathan, Kolter et al. (34 authors)
method: Compute-matched study of injecting domain (finetuning) data during pretraining/mid-training versus finetuning alone; measures data efficiency of replaying generic pretraining data during finetuning.
headline_claim: Replay of generic pretraining data during finetuning prevents forgetting and improves target performance, increasing data efficiency by up to 2.06x for mid-training; finetuning-only needs a larger model than pretraining a smaller one with domain data
path_relevance: Quantifies replay ratio and the cost-benefit of domain injection at mid-training vs finetuning on an existing base.

title: Improving Sparse Memory Finetuning
first_author: Goyal, Kanchi, Shah, Gupta
method: Retrofits Qwen-2.5-0.5B by replacing FFN layers 8/12/16 with sparse key-value memory layers, heals on 20k samples, then KL-based slot selection for continual finetuning.
headline_claim: Retrofitted models acquire new facts with minimal forgetting of held-out capabilities
path_relevance: Only found open recipe for adding memory layers to an existing checkpoint (small scale).

title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models: Phenomenology, Mechanism, and Recipe
first_author: Li, Zuo, He, Zhang, Xiao, Qian, Yu, Gao, Yang, Liu, Ding
method: Mechanistic study of when OPD fails; two-stage off-policy SFT cold start then OPD.
headline_claim: 'A stronger teacher can completely fail to improve a student, even when a weaker teacher succeeds'
path_relevance: Failure modes of the consolidation step now standard in frontier post-training.
frontier_adoption: Cites Qwen3, MiMo, GLM-5 OPD pipelines

title: Shuffle the Context: RoPE-Perturbed Self-Distillation for Long-Context Adaptation
first_author: Li, Liang, Ren, Zhao, Shen, Chen
method: Regularizer that perturbs RoPE indices to create alternative views of a sequence and self-distills between them during long-context fine-tuning.
headline_claim: Reduces positional variance of accuracy after long-context adaptation
path_relevance: Robustness fix for long-context CPT on open bases.

title: Expert Upcycling: Shifting the Compute-Efficient Frontier of Mixture-of-Experts
first_author: Dwivedi, Huang, Gupta, Jayarao, Varshney, Yin
method: Expands an E-expert MoE to mE experts during CPT by duplication + router extension with fixed top-K; utility-based (gradient importance) non-uniform duplication.
headline_claim: Upcycled 13B matches the fixed-size baseline loss while saving ~32% GPU hours; utility-based selection more than triples gap closure under limited CPT
path_relevance: Expert expansion of an existing MoE base (previously little studied).

title: TokAlign++: Advancing Vocabulary Adaptation via Better Token Alignment
first_author: Li, Deng, Yang, Zhang, Zong
tier_evidence: No review signal found (journal-style formatting, venue unknown)
method: Token-alignment based vocabulary adaptation across LLM tokenizers (Gemma 256k, LLaMA3 128k, Qwen2 152k) for multilingual/code compression.
headline_claim: Improves over FVT/Focus-style heuristics for vocabulary adaptation
path_relevance: Newest vocabulary-change method for open bases.

title: Forgetting in Language Models: Capacity, Optimization, and Self-Generated Replay
first_author: Marek, Cho, Qiu, Chunara, Izmailov, Wilson
tier_evidence: No review signal found (arXiv, May 2026; NeurIPS 2026 decisions pending)
method: Uses the model's own samples as replay data during continued training and analyses when forgetting persists (capacity-limited regime).
headline_claim: Self-generated samples serve as effective replay data, nearly eliminating forgetting, except when the model has little remaining capacity
path_relevance: Replay without access to the original pretraining corpus, the typical constraint when continuing an open-weights base.

title: SPRI: SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization for Data-Constrained MoE Upcycling
first_author: Shan, Mao, Li, Zhang, Luo, Zheng, Xu, Qiao, Jin, Yuan, Chen, Xiao, Zhu
affiliations: Northeastern University (China), Huawei, CUHK-Shenzhen, Ant Group, NiuTrans
method: Distributes SVD-partitioned residuals of pretrained FFN weights across routed experts for diversity; two-stage adaptation.
headline_claim: Improves upcycling when supervised data is limited
path_relevance: Upcycling under data constraints (non-CPT regime).

title: Jet-Long: Efficient Long-Context Extension with Dynamic Bifocal RoPE
first_author: Tang, Wang, Gu, Han, Cai
method: Zero-shot context extension with a dynamic bifocal RoPE rescaling instead of a single fixed factor.
headline_claim: Zero-shot extension is 'the dominant deployment path for open-weight checkpoints'; dynamic bifocal scaling beats single-factor rescaling
path_relevance: Newest YaRN successor targeting open checkpoints.

title: When Model Merging Rivals Joint Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning: A Task-Vector Geometry Analysis
first_author: McClendon
method: Trains Qwen3-8B AppWorld specialists with LOOP, merges (TIES, RAM+) and compares against joint RL on identical data.
headline_claim: Merging matches joint RL on task completion; all merge variants statistically indistinguishable because RL task vectors are near-orthogonal
path_relevance: Direct test of merging-as-substitute-for-multi-task-RL.

title: Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation
first_author: Yu, Xu, Xu, Zhou, Lin
method: Builds a proxy teacher in logit space from a contrast pair of small models (post-RL vs pre-RL; large vs small base; hinted vs unhinted) added to the student's base logits.
headline_claim: Consistently outperforms OPD and lets the student surpass the domain teacher when no stronger teacher exists
path_relevance: Post-training route when the open base is already the largest model available.

title: Open-MOPD: Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
first_author: Gao, Chi, Yan, Feng, Wu, Jiang, ... et al.
method: Controlled M-OPD benchmark on SmolLM3-3B-Base with oracle routing; token-share balancing, gap-aware budget allocation, student reward refresh.
headline_claim: Standard M-OPD recovers only 35.6% of the SFT->RouteRL gap; Open-MOPD raises it to 83.4%
path_relevance: Open reproducible recipe for the specialist-consolidation step used by GLM-5.2 and Nemotron 3 Ultra.
frontier_adoption: Method family used by GLM-5.2, DeepSeek-V4, Nemotron 3 Ultra
